import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from harness import *
EMPTY=sha(b'')
def A(payload,pn,ann=0,phase=0,dcid=b'\xaa',width=None):
    w = width if width else 4
    return datagram((0x40|(phase<<2)|(w-1)).to_bytes(1,'big')+dcid+pn.to_bytes(w,'big')+payload,[ann])
def I(payload,pn=0,ann=0):
    return datagram(bytes([0xc1])+b'\0\0\0\1'+b'\x01\xaa'+b'\x01\xbb'+v(0)+v(2+len(payload))+pn.to_bytes(2,'big')+payload,[ann])
PING=b'\x01'
# key removal/reinstall retains epoch and history
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(PING,0),{'keys':['I']},{'keys':['A']}, A(PING,1), A(PING,0), A(PING,5,ann=1,phase=1)]))
check('reinstall',[p['status'] for p in t['packets']],['OK','OK','DUPLICATE','OK'])
check('reinstall-epoch',(t['key_epoch'],t['received']['A']),(1,5))
# duplicate detection across key changes for I
t=one(trace([{'keys':['I']}, I(PING,0),{'keys':['I','H']}, I(PING,0)]))
check('dup-across-keys',[p['status'] for p in t['packets']],['OK','DUPLICATE'])
# send reference implicit open on client stream
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x11'+v(4)+v(1),0)]))
check('send-implicit',(t['opened'],[s['id'] for s in t['streams']]),({'bidi':2,'uni':0},[4]))
# stream rows for send-only references
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x11'+v(0)+v(7),0)]))
check('send-only-row',(t['streams'][0]['id'],t['streams'][0]['send_max'],t['streams'][0]['high'],t['streams'][0]['final']),(0,7,0,None))

t=one(trace([{'keys':['A','I']},
             I(b'\x06'+v(0)+v(2)+b'ab'),
             I(b'\x06'+v(2)+v(2)+b'cd'),
             A(b'\x06'+v(0)+v(1)+b'x',0)]))
check('crypto-merge',(t['crypto'][0]['ranges'],t['crypto'][0]['prefix'],t['crypto'][0]['sha256'],t['crypto'][2]['ranges']),
      ([[0,4]],4,sha(b'abcd'),[[0,1]]))
# stream prefix with hole then fill
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0c'+v(0)+v(2)+b'ab',0), A(b'\x0c'+v(2)+v(2)+b'cd',1)]))

# reset then crypto unaffected

check('reset-discard',(t['streams'][0]['ranges'],t['streams'][0]['unique'],t['streams'][0]['high'],t['streams'][0]['final'],t['streams'][0]['reset']),

# ack union at A level only

# ack interval spanning seeds

# expected from seed: raw 0x05 with expected 5 -> 5

check('seed-expected',(t['packets'][0]['pn'],t['packets'][0]['status']),(5,'OK'))
# canonical width with seed expectation: pn 5, expected 5 -> width 1
